name: Holy Smite
summary: Damage evil creatures in a burst and blind those that fail their saves.
description: Good creatures are unaffected. Evil creatures take 1d8 damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8), while evil outsiders instead take 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 10d6); they are also blinded for 1 round. A successful Will save halves the damage and negates blindness. Neutral creatures take half the normal evil-creature damage and are not blinded; a successful save reduces that damage by half again.
